test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 22 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements: **Some seats are plates. All plates are chairs.

**Conclusion (I):** Some seats are chairs.

**Conclusion (II):** All chairs are plates.
solution:
**Given Statements:**

Some seats are plates.**
All plates are chairs.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cf2b52906de4f350dafa435b3dbeec6e7e28e73603961c035adc177c90d638c0.png] 

**Conclusions:**

**(I) Some seats are chairs:** Follows **(because some seats are plates and all plates are chairs.)

**(II) All chairs are plates:** **Does not follows** (because only plates are chairs is given, not all chairs are plates.

Therefore, only conclusion **(I)** follows.

Hence, the correct answer is **Option 2**.
